description_en: Queries the log files that are generated by the SQL Explorer (SQL Audit) feature for an instance. The DescribeSQLLogFiles operation does not return the log files that are generated by the SQL Explorer feature and manually exported from the ApsaraDB RDS console. The DescribeSQLLogFiles operation returns the SQL Explorer log files that are generated by calling the DescribeSQLLogRecords operation with the request parameter Form set to File
description_zh: 该接口用于查询SQL洞察（SQL审计）导出文件列表。不支持查询通过控制台手动导出的SQL洞察日志文件，只支持查询通过DescribeSQLLogRecords接口生成（请求参数Form取值为File）的SQL洞察文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-sql-log-files --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --file-name custins0000.csv --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSQLLogFiles

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the audit log file
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

LogFile.description_en: An array that consists of the returned audit log files

LogDownloadURL.description_en: The download URL of the file. If the audit log file cannot be downloaded, this parameter is null
LogDownloadURL.description_zh: 下载地址。若当前不可下载，则为空

LogEndTime.description_en: The time at which the last SQL statement recorded in the audit log file was executed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

LogSize.description_en: The size of the audit log file. Unit: bytes

LogStartTime.description_en: The time at which the first SQL statement recorded in the audit log file was executed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

LogStatus.description_en:
The status of the audit log file. Valid values:

Success
Failed
Generating
LogStatus.description_zh:
文件当前状态，取值：
Success：生成成功
Failed：生成失败
Generating：生成中

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
